release_read.basis: Revenue missed (1.481bn vs ~1.51bn), HOKA grew only 6.8% with management citing franchise updates not resonating, and the FY sales outlook was trimmed; the raised EPS guide (7.80-7.95) contains ~$0.52 of refunds already received, so ex-refund it sits at or slightly below the prior 7.35-7.50. The refund thesis was realised but is a one-off the guide now caps, while the growth line the stock trades on (HOKA) disappointed.

release.headline: Deckers Brands Reports Second Quarter Fiscal Year 2027 Financial Results

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback)
Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback); ex-refund figure is 2.31 - 0.28 from the release

key_line.metric: IEEPA refund recognition and HOKA growth
key_line.detail: Refund recognised: $46.0m net plus $3.0m interest in Q2 ($0.28 EPS); FY guide includes $87.9m + $4.7m received through 2026-10-08 (~$0.52) and assumes no further collection. HOKA +6.8% to $677.2m, UGG +3.5% to $786.4m; management said some calendar-2026 HOKA franchise updates did not resonate as expected.

guidance.detail: FY27 net sales $5.700-5.725bn (trimmed per press); diluted EPS $7.80-7.95 vs prior $7.35-7.50, of which ~$0.52 is refunds already received, so ex-refund ~$7.28-7.43, at or slightly below the prior range. HOKA guided high-single-digit, UGG low-single-digit growth.

call.detail: Call described as 'margin strength, measured outlook'; adjusted gross margin 57.4% (+120bp); US market described as more challenging, international/APAC strong; HOKA franchise updates not resonating. Not read in full (time).

public_reaction.summary: Headlines frame it as EPS beat / sales miss with a refund-driven guide raise; Investing.com transcript headline 'beats EPS but shares drop 7.3%'. No dated analyst action from this morning found in the time available (a Citi $150->$120 cut surfaced in search but its date could not be confirmed, so it is not used). Retail tone not checked.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 78.10 = -8.4% vs prev close 85.28 (after-hours -7.3%), against a frozen release read of -6.0% and an implied move of 9.8%. Pre-market is alive (127 prints, 20 in the last 30 min, last print 09:11, not stale) and has drifted lower overnight (AH 79.07 -> 78.1, range 76.8-79.4). Market is mildly down (SPY -0.4%, IWM -0.6%). Position is long from 87.44, so ~-10.6% so far.

thesis_check.note: The refund leg came true (booked $0.28 in Q2 and $0.52 in the guide), but the guide now caps it ('no further collection'), and the line the stock trades on, HOKA growth and the sales outlook, disappointed. The thesis leg was real; it did not outweigh the growth miss.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market with 127 prints and a last print at 09:11, so the open should hold the -8% gap; a sizeable amc gap slightly beyond what the release supports (frozen read -6%) leans toward a partial give-back in the first half hour, tempered by a weak tape and DECK's history of persistent post-print moves.

recommendation.reason: De long staat ruim 10% verlies; de cijfers zijn zwak (omzet onder verwachting, HOKA groeit traag, winstverhoging komt vooral uit eenmalige tariefteruggaven), maar de daling van ruim 8% voorbeurs is iets groter dan wat de cijfers alleen rechtvaardigen. Grote openingsgaten geven vaak in het eerste half uur een deel terug, dus om 10:00 verkopen in plaats van op de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 verder wegzakt onder 76,80 of er een reeks koersdoelverlagingen binnenkomt, dan direct op de opening verkopen.
